responsibility: Implements the lint that detects null checks performed on function pointers after casting them to raw pointers. It analyzes late expression forms such as `.is_null()` calls, direct `ptr::is_null` calls, and equality comparisons against `0`, `ptr::null()`, or `ptr::null_mut()`, recognizes cast chains originating from function-pointer-typed expressions, and warns because Rust function pointers are assumed to be non-null so these checks are always false.
